item.omnimine.bedrock_pickaxe.desc1: Unbreakable. Hold left click to mine mobs, the Sun, the Moon and lightning.
item.omnimine.bedrock_pickaxe.desc2: Sneak + hold left click on a structure: mine the whole thing.
item.omnimine.bedrock_pickaxe.desc3: Right click: call down a lightning bolt (to mine afterwards).
item.omnimine.sun_sword.desc1: Power 1: every hit ignites the target and triggers a solar eruption.
item.omnimine.sun_sword.desc2: Power 2 (right click): a beam of the Sun hits where you aim and leaves a molten crater.
item.omnimine.moon_boots.desc1: Power 1: lunar gravity, two extra jumps in the air, no fall damage.
item.omnimine.moon_boots.desc2: Power 2: sneak in mid-air to dive and cause a lunar impact.
item.omnimine.lightning_helmet.desc1: Chain lightning: every melee hit makes lightning jump from enemy to enemy.
item.omnimine.lightning_helmet.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
item.omnimine.lightning_chestplate.desc1: Static discharge: when you are hit, a sphere of lightning strikes everything around you. Lightning immunity.
item.omnimine.lightning_chestplate.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
item.omnimine.lightning_leggings.desc1: Thunder run: while sprinting, crazy speed, an electric trail that hurls enemies, and lightning strikes the nearest one.
item.omnimine.lightning_leggings.desc2: Obtained by mining a lightning bolt.
message.omnimine.need_enchant: The pickaxe needs the Omnimining enchantment (librarian book, 1 emerald block).
message.omnimine.sun_gone: The Sun has vanished from the sky...
message.omnimine.moon_gone: The Moon has vanished from the sky...
tooltip.omnimine.omni_on: Omnimining active: everything can be mined.
tooltip.omnimine.omni_off: Without the Omnimining enchantment it only mines blocks.
tooltip.omnimine.structure_useless: On its own, this structure is useless.
tooltip.omnimine.structure_craft: Crafting table: in the center, surrounded by 8 × %s → evolved version.
tooltip.omnimine.evolved: Evolved structure: a mine of cheat items.
item.omnimine.mob_skeleton.desc1: Bone Storm: a rain of bone shards falls on the targeted area.
item.omnimine.mob_creeper.desc1: Green Blast: the targeted area charges up, then explodes.
item.omnimine.mob_zombie.desc1: Plague Breath: a rotten mist poisons and weakens enemies, and heals you.
item.omnimine.mob_spider.desc1: Giant Web: threads fall on the area, pulling in and entangling enemies.
item.omnimine.mob_guardian.desc1: Guardian Beam: a beam charges up, then pierces everything for 38 blocks, enemies and terrain.
item.omnimine.mob_villager.desc1: Village Scream: three sound waves push everything away, shatter glass and make emeralds pop out.
item.omnimine.mob_iron_golem.desc1: Golem Slam: the ground splits into a star and everything is thrown into the air.
item.omnimine.mob_enderman.desc1: Shadow Step: you teleport to where you aim, smashing everything on the way.
